channel.title: Essays by Malory
channel.description: Essays on fiction, craft, and the male reader from Malory — Sci-Fi, LitRPG and Progression Fantasy author.

item.title: The Art of the Bait-and-Switch Chapter End
item.description: How a well-placed bait-and-switch chapter ending keeps readers binge-reading — and how it breaks the book when it goes wrong. Wednesday Deconstruction series.

item.title: Using First-Person Narrative Voice
item.description: A working novelist's take on when first-person narrative voice earns its place — and when it doesn't. Part of the Wednesday Deconstruction craft series.

item.title: The Curious Case of the Male Reader
item.description: What the data actually says about the male reading decline — and what it means for fiction. From Malory's PhD research on men's reading habits.

item.title: What You Told Me About Boys and Books
item.description: Reader responses on the boys-and-books question, and what the patterns in those responses reveal about how fiction lost its male audience.
